rankingFormula: score = 0.50*temporal + 0.35*topological + 0.15*traffic; dt = reference - change.valid.start in whole seconds, signed, published as signed_time_distance_seconds (time_distance_seconds is dt floored at 0); temporal = exp(-dt/tau) for dt >= 0 and kappa*exp(-|dt|/tau_post) for dt < 0, with tau = 1800s, kappa = 0.5 and tau_post = tau/2 = 900s, so a post-reference candidate (post_reference = true) never takes the maximum temporal weight; topological = 1/(1+h) with h = hops from the focus to the nearest resolved target, h = hop_cap+1 = 3 for an unattached change; traffic = (1+w)/6 with w = heaviest traffic weight class on that path, 0 for unattached targets and for edge types that carry no class; reference = 2026-09-21T16:00:00Z; components rounded to 6 decimals; ties broken by change_id ascending (research §9, ADR-0005 D4, docs/schema/ranking.md)
